summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K updating its share buyback programme. The company amended its agreement with J.P. Morgan Securities plc to increase the aggregate maximum from USD 1.2 billion to USD 1.472 billion, representing approximately 4% of issued share capital at the closing price on 1 September 2026. The programme was originally announced 6 January 2026 and must be completed by 18 December 2026. No guarantee the programme will be fully implemented. What to watch: pace of repurchases and share price support.
